$comment: Traditional Chinese typography: corner brackets 「」 (Apple zh-TW Finder/AppKit/SystemSettings: 911 「 vs 30 curly quotes, all in sample strings), 『』 nested per the Taiwan MOE standard (unattested in the pile, so restructure before nesting). No apostrophe: Chinese has none. Ellipsis ⋯ (U+22EF), as macOS writes it (pile values: zh-TW 250 ⋯ / 0 …, zh-HK 249 / 0). A space between Han and any Latin word or digit, except inside a Chinese date compound (8月1日). The spacing rules skip inserts (U+FFFC; a plural or select node reads in place, branch by branch): an insert may render Han ({label}) or Latin ({duration}), so its spacing is judged by hand (style.md § Spacing). Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: a space separates Han from a following Latin word or number (`macOS 通知`, `約 5 分鐘`); only a date compound stays tight (`年7月`, `月1日`)
a space separates a Latin word or number from the Han after it (`USB 裝置`, `App 中`); only a date compound stays tight (`8月`, `1日`)

hedges.why: a bracketed plural suffix, pronoun, or classifier (`這（些）`, `使用者（們）`, `他（她）`); Chinese needs none: drop it, or name the count with ICU plural

hedges.pattern: (?:這|那)/(?:這|那)些|[他她]/[他她]|[個張部支項位]/[個張部支項位]
hedges.why: a slashed number, gender, or classifier alternative; use the neutral form (`這些`, `你`, the noun's own classifier) or rephrase
